title: Content Security Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the Content Security Policy for a frontend application. Enforces: no unsafe-inline without nonce, base-uri restricted, frame-ancestors declared, no wildcard source origins.

error_codes.CP001: csp-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: directives{}, reportUri
error_codes.CP002: 'unsafe-inline' used in script-src without nonce — use nonces or hashes instead
error_codes.CP003: base-uri directive not defined — prevents base tag injection attacks
error_codes.CP004: frame-ancestors not defined — either restrict to self or explicitly allow embedding origins
error_codes.CP005: Wildcard (*) used as source in a CSP directive — enumerate allowed origins explicitly
